dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: Hello! Are you going to Sumeru City? Do you need a bodyguard? I was the one who escorted Gohar into the city!

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: Whoa, you're confident. If you're that strong, why don't you join the Eremites?

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: You'll have a pretty good life if you can handle security jobs or escorting cargos.

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: I think Brother Aybak is doing it for our safety, but he always gives us jobs that don't require traveling to the city or facing any danger.

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: I can't deny that it's easy, but it's so boring! Even window shopping and counting Harra Fruits would be more interesting than those commissions.

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: See you. Let me know if you come across any commissions in Sumeru City!

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: Oh, sorry. I forgot outsiders don't know about Gohar.

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: She is a beautiful lady that everyone here in Caravan Ribat likes. Whoever meets her can't help but say a few words of praise to her.

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: It's a pity you can't get to meet her in person. Some weeks ago, she received a letter from a Dusk Bird, then she asked me to send her to Sumeru City.

dialogues.speaker: Safie
dialogues.text: It was so much fun...! Um, I mean, it was an unforgettable work experience!
